title: Bee Maid Honey
description:
Bee Maid Honey Limited is the marketing arm of the Alberta Honey Producers Cooperative Limited 
and the Manitoba Cooperative Honey Producers Limited. Honey produced by beekeepers in western C
anada is processed and packaged at Bee Maid's Winnipeg, MB and Spruce Grove, AB plants.

We will upload 46gb of corporate data soon. Employee personal information (passports numbers, D
